# A Leader in High Temperature Solutions

Since 1965, Aremco has been a leader in the development and production of high-temperature
adhesives, coatings, potting compounds, and technical ceramics.
[Our Products][83] [Get In Touch][84]

## Featured Product Categories

[[High Temperature Mounting Adhesives]][85]

### High Temperature Mounting Adhesives

For dicing ceramics, semiconductors, and single crystalline materials.

[Read More][86]

[[HiE-Coat™ 840-M]][87]

### High Temperature High Emissivity Coatings

Black-body coatings for applications to 2,500°F

[Read More][88]

[[Ceramabond™ 670]][89]

### High Temperature Ceramic Adhesives

For bonding, potting and sealing to 3,200°F.

[Read More][90]

[[Aremcolox 502-600]][91]

### Machinable Ceramics

Alumina Aluminum Nitride, Alumino-Silicate, Boron Nitride, Glass Ceramics, Magnesia, Zirconia.

[Read More][92]

## Customer Driven, Application Focused, and Committed to Quality

At Aremco, we prioritize our customers by building strong relationships, understanding their needs,
and offering personalized solutions with expert support.

With decades of experience in high-temperature materials, we offer innovative products like
adhesives, coatings, sealants, and ceramics designed for extreme condition

# Advanced tungsten carbide engineering, hard material innovations and precision tool solutions for
# global industrial applications

## **Our Solutions**

For over 100 years, we have been developing and producing sophisticated cutting tools and hard
material solutions: From highly specialized [cutting tools][8], indexable inserts and [carbide
rods][9] to new types of carbide and cermet grades for [wear protection][10] as well as wood and
stone working.

Through constant innovation, introspection and ingenuity we blaze the path to unrivalled quality,
only matched by our passion for 360° service and loyal, long-lasting partnerships.

[Read more][11]

## Know Your Product Carbon Footprint

Our goal is to establish a common standard on the market for calculating and classifying the carbon
footprint of cutting tools, hard material solutions and tungsten carbide powders. In this way, we
will be able to provide customers the carbon footprint transparency they require.

[Read more][12]

## Career at CERATIZIT

**Are you looking for a career that lets you build on your strengths?**

As one of the world's leading companies in carbide solutions and precision tools, we offer you a
diverse environment in which you and your passion for the industry can thrive.

[Read more][13]

## Corporate Culture and Values

At CERATIZIT, people come first. Guided by our values and driven by creativity, collaboration, and
integrity, we empower employees to innovate, share ideas, and shape a sustainable future together.
Join a culture where diversity thrives, decisions are fast, and passion fuels progress.

[Read more][14]

## Passion for Cemented Carbide

**Cemented carbide from CERATIZIT for high wear demands**

CERATIZIT manages the entire production process chain of cemented carbide and cemented carbide
components, from powder preparation to forming, sintering, finishing and surface treatment. The
blanks are subjected to grinding, polishing and EDM machining and are then given an innovative
wear-resistant coating, when necessary. This ensures that our carbide products have the properties
required for industrial applications.

[Read more][15]

## Latest News

# Advanced tungsten carbide engineering, hard material innovations and precision tool solutions for
# global industrial applications

## **Our Solutions**

For over 100 years, we have been developing and producing sophisticated cutting tools and hard
material solutions: From highly specialized [cutting tools][8], indexable inserts and [carbide
rods][9] to new types of carbide and cermet grades for [wear protection][10] as well as wood and
stone working.

Through constant innovation, introspection and ingenuity we blaze the path to unrivalled quality,
only matched by our passion for 360° service and loyal, long-lasting partnerships.

[Read more][11]

## Know Your Product Carbon Footprint

Our goal is to establish a common standard on the market for calculating and classifying the carbon
footprint of cutting tools, hard material solutions and tungsten carbide powders. In this way, we
will be able to provide customers the carbon footprint transparency they require.

[Read more][12]

## Career at CERATIZIT

**Are you looking for a career that lets you build on your strengths?**

As one of the world's leading companies in carbide solutions and precision tools, we offer you a
diverse environment in which you and your passion for the industry can thrive.

[Read more][13]

## Corporate Culture and Values

At CERATIZIT, people come first. Guided by our values and driven by creativity, collaboration, and
integrity, we empower employees to innovate, share ideas, and shape a sustainable future together.
Join a culture where diversity thrives, decisions are fast, and passion fuels progress.

[Read more][14]

## Passion for Cemented Carbide

**Cemented carbide from CERATIZIT for high wear demands**

CERATIZIT manages the entire production process chain of cemented carbide and cemented carbide
components, from powder preparation to forming, sintering, finishing and surface treatment. The
blanks are subjected to grinding, polishing and EDM machining and are then given an innovative
wear-resistant coating, when necessary. This ensures that our carbide products have the properties
required for industrial applications.

[Read more][15]

## Latest News

# H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders:
# Unser Know-how für Ihren Erfolg

Wir sind H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders, ein Unternehmen der Mitsubishi Materials Corporation. Seit
mehr als 100 Jahren entwickeln und produzieren wir für unsere Kunden hochwertige Pulver aus dem
Refraktärmetall Wolfram und dessen Verbindungen. Unser Produktspektrum reicht von Wolframaten bis zu
Wolframcarbiden in ultrafeinen bis groben Korngrößen. Sie alle entsprechen höchsten Ansprüchen an
Qualität und Leistungsfähigkeit. Dank der umfassenden Kompetenz unserer Teams in Chemie und
Metallurgie beschreiten wir auch innovative Wege, um für Sie die Lösung mit optimalem Mehrwert zu
entwickeln. Das heißt für unsere Kunden: Sie erhalten exakt das Pulver, das ihren individuellen
Anforderungen entspricht.

## Wir sind H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders

[DE innovativ] Innovativ Wir verbinden Erfahrung mit Innovationsgeist. Hochqualifizierte Teams in
Forschung & Entwicklung und in der Anwendungstechnik widmen sich den Lösungen von morgen. So
entwickeln wir in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden maßgeschneiderte Lösungen mit
herausragenden Materialeigenschaften. Nachhaltig Verlässlich [DE nachhaltig] Innovativ Nachhaltig
Verlässlich Nachhaltigkeit ist ein fester Bestandteil unserer Unternehmensstrategie. Mithilfe einer
eigenen Technologie gewinnen wir den Großteil unseres Rohstoffs durch Recycling. Ergänzend dazu
haben wir über unseren Eigentümer Masan High-Tech Materials Zugriff auf konfliktfreien
Primärrohstoff. Die laufende Optimierung von Prozessen und Verfahren trägt dazu bei, den Verbrauch
von Energie und Hilfsstoffen zu optimieren.
Seit 2023 ist unser deutscher Standort nach EMAS zertifiziert. [DE verlässlich] Innovativ Nachhaltig
Verlässlich Versorgungssicherheit ist für unsere Kunden ein zentrales Thema. Wir haben Zugang zu
Primär- und Sekundärrohstoffen und sind damit unabhängig von Quellen beispielsweise in China.
Das macht uns zu einem verlässlichen Partner.

## Unsere Produkte für Ihre Branche

Wolfram ist dank seiner besonderen Eigenschaften in vielen Schlüsselindustrien unverzichtbar.
Verschaffen Sie sich einen Überblick der Branchen, in denen hochwertige, individuelle Wolframpulver
von H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders zur Anwendung kommen.

### [Maschinen- und Werkzeugbau][35]

Hochleistungswerkzeuge sind aus dem Maschinenbau nicht wegzudenken. Die kontinuierliche Steigerung
ihrer Präzision, in Kombination mit erhöhter Lebensdauer, ermöglicht den Anwendern ein optimiertes
Arbeiten. H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders liefert die dazu notwendigen hochreinen und
anwendungsspezifischen Wolframcarbidpulver.

[Icon | Maschinenbau | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

# H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders:
# Unser Know-how für Ihren Erfolg

Wir sind H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders, ein Unternehmen der Mitsubishi Materials Corporation. Seit
mehr als 100 Jahren entwickeln und produzieren wir für unsere Kunden hochwertige Pulver aus dem
Refraktärmetall Wolfram und dessen Verbindungen. Unser Produktspektrum reicht von Wolframaten bis zu
Wolframcarbiden in ultrafeinen bis groben Korngrößen. Sie alle entsprechen höchsten Ansprüchen an
Qualität und Leistungsfähigkeit. Dank der umfassenden Kompetenz unserer Teams in Chemie und
Metallurgie beschreiten wir auch innovative Wege, um für Sie die Lösung mit optimalem Mehrwert zu
entwickeln. Das heißt für unsere Kunden: Sie erhalten exakt das Pulver, das ihren individuellen
Anforderungen entspricht.

## Wir sind H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders

[DE innovativ] Innovativ Wir verbinden Erfahrung mit Innovationsgeist. Hochqualifizierte Teams in
Forschung & Entwicklung und in der Anwendungstechnik widmen sich den Lösungen von morgen. So
entwickeln wir in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden maßgeschneiderte Lösungen mit
herausragenden Materialeigenschaften. Nachhaltig Verlässlich [DE nachhaltig] Innovativ Nachhaltig
Verlässlich Nachhaltigkeit ist ein fester Bestandteil unserer Unternehmensstrategie. Mithilfe einer
eigenen Technologie gewinnen wir den Großteil unseres Rohstoffs durch Recycling. Ergänzend dazu
haben wir über unseren Eigentümer Masan High-Tech Materials Zugriff auf konfliktfreien
Primärrohstoff. Die laufende Optimierung von Prozessen und Verfahren trägt dazu bei, den Verbrauch
von Energie und Hilfsstoffen zu optimieren.
Seit 2023 ist unser deutscher Standort nach EMAS zertifiziert. [DE verlässlich] Innovativ Nachhaltig
Verlässlich Versorgungssicherheit ist für unsere Kunden ein zentrales Thema. Wir haben Zugang zu
Primär- und Sekundärrohstoffen und sind damit unabhängig von Quellen beispielsweise in China.
Das macht uns zu einem verlässlichen Partner.

## Unsere Produkte für Ihre Branche

Wolfram ist dank seiner besonderen Eigenschaften in vielen Schlüsselindustrien unverzichtbar.
Verschaffen Sie sich einen Überblick der Branchen, in denen hochwertige, individuelle Wolframpulver
von H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders zur Anwendung kommen.

### [Maschinen- und Werkzeugbau][35]

Hochleistungswerkzeuge sind aus dem Maschinenbau nicht wegzudenken. Die kontinuierliche Steigerung
ihrer Präzision, in Kombination mit erhöhter Lebensdauer, ermöglicht den Anwendern ein optimiertes
Arbeiten. H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders liefert die dazu notwendigen hochreinen und
anwendungsspezifischen Wolframcarbidpulver.

[Icon | Maschinenbau | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

### [Automobilindustrie][36]

Die Fertigungstechnologien im modernen Automobilbau erfordern hochleistungsfähige
Hartmetallwerkzeuge – beispielsweise für die Bearbeitung von Motorblöcken oder Bremsen. Unsere
hochwertigen Wolframcarbidpulver eignen sich optimal für die Herstellung von Werkzeugen zum Spanen,
Umformen und für die Metallbearbeitung allgemein.

[Icon | Automobilindustrie | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

### [Luftfahrt][37]

Ausgerechnet in der Luftfahrt, wo sich alles um Leichtbau dreht, kommt eines der schwersten Metalle
überhaupt zum Einsatz: Wolfram oder Wolframlegierungen werden hier wegen ihrer hohen Dichte und
Festigkeit in Ausgleichsgewichten, Vibrationsschutzteilen für Ladeklappen oder zum Ausbalancieren
von Rotorblättern eingesetzt.

[Icon | Luft- und Raumfahrt | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

### [Öl- und Gasbranche][38]

H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders entwickelt und produziert Wolframpulver speziell für den Einsatz in der
Öl- und Gasexploration. Das Technologiemetall kommt nicht nur in Hochleistungsbohrköpfen zum
Einsatz, sondern auch in Hohlladungen, die das Gestein rund um ein Bohrloch perforieren, damit Öl
und Gas abfließen können.

[Icon | Öl- und Gasexploration | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

### [Chemische Industrie][39]

In der chemischen Industrie gibt es vielfältige Möglichkeiten Wolfram anzuwenden, insbesondere im
Bereich der Katalysatoren, wie zum Beispiel Oxidationskatalysatoren. Und wir verstehen es, die
passenden Wolframchemikalien herzustellen.

[Icon | Chemische Industrie | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

### [Medizintechnik][40]

Die Medizintechnik nutzt Wolfram, um Geräte leistungsfähiger und schonender zu machen.
Präzisionsbauteile aus Wolframmetall werden beispielsweise in der modernen Röntgendiagnostik und
-therapie eingesetzt, um harte Röntgen- oder Gammastrahlung abzuschirmen und zu fokussieren.

[Medizintechnik | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

### [Elektroindustrie][41]

Eine hohe thermische Belastbarkeit von Wolfram-Kupfer-Werkstoffen in Kombination mit sehr guten
Wärme- und guten elektrischen Leitfähigkeiten prädestinieren diese Materialien für Anwendungen in
elektrischen Hochleistungsschaltkontakten, als Wärmesenken in der Elektroindustrie oder zum Einsatz
als Erodierelektroden.

[Icon | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

Wir verarbeiten wolframhaltige Recyclingmaterialien zu hochleistungsfähigen Wolframverbindungen und

Verlässlich Nachhaltigkeit ist ein fester Bestandteil unserer Unternehmensstrategie. Mithilfe einer
eigenen Technologie gewinnen wir den Großteil unseres Rohstoffs durch Recycling. Ergänzend dazu
haben wir über unseren Eigentümer Masan High-Tech Materials Zugriff auf konfliktfreien
Primärrohstoff. Die laufende Optimierung von Prozessen und Verfahren trägt dazu bei, den Verbrauch
von Energie und Hilfsstoffen zu optimieren.
Seit 2023 ist unser deutscher Standort nach EMAS zertifiziert. [DE verlässlich] Innovativ Nachhaltig
Verlässlich Versorgungssicherheit ist für unsere Kunden ein zentrales Thema. Wir haben Zugang zu
Primär- und Sekundärrohstoffen und sind damit unabhängig von Quellen beispielsweise in China.
Das macht uns zu einem verlässlichen Partner.

## Unsere Produkte für Ihre Branche

Wolfram ist dank seiner besonderen Eigenschaften in vielen Schlüsselindustrien unverzichtbar.
Verschaffen Sie sich einen Überblick der Branchen, in denen hochwertige, individuelle Wolframpulver
von H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders zur Anwendung kommen.

### [Maschinen- und Werkzeugbau][35]

Hochleistungswerkzeuge sind aus dem Maschinenbau nicht wegzudenken. Die kontinuierliche Steigerung
ihrer Präzision, in Kombination mit erhöhter Lebensdauer, ermöglicht den Anwendern ein optimiertes
Arbeiten. H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders liefert die dazu notwendigen hochreinen und
anwendungsspezifischen Wolframcarbidpulver.

[Icon | Maschinenbau | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

### [Automobilindustrie][36]

Die Fertigungstechnologien im modernen Automobilbau erfordern hochleistungsfähige
Hartmetallwerkzeuge – beispielsweise für die Bearbeitung von Motorblöcken oder Bremsen. Unsere
hochwertigen Wolframcarbidpulver eignen sich optimal für die Herstellung von Werkzeugen zum Spanen,
Umformen und für die Metallbearbeitung allgemein.

[Icon | Automobilindustrie | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

### [Luftfahrt][37]

Ausgerechnet in der Luftfahrt, wo sich alles um Leichtbau dreht, kommt eines der schwersten Metalle
überhaupt zum Einsatz: Wolfram oder Wolframlegierungen werden hier wegen ihrer hohen Dichte und
Festigkeit in Ausgleichsgewichten, Vibrationsschutzteilen für Ladeklappen oder zum Ausbalancieren
von Rotorblättern eingesetzt.

[Icon | Luft- und Raumfahrt | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

### [Öl- und Gasbranche][38]

H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders entwickelt und produziert Wolframpulver speziell für den Einsatz in der
Öl- und Gasexploration. Das Technologiemetall kommt nicht nur in Hochleistungsbohrköpfen zum
Einsatz, sondern auch in Hohlladungen, die das Gestein rund um ein Bohrloch perforieren, damit Öl
und Gas abfließen können.

[Icon | Öl- und Gasexploration | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

### [Chemische Industrie][39]

In der chemischen Industrie gibt es vielfältige Möglichkeiten Wolfram anzuwenden, insbesondere im
Bereich der Katalysatoren, wie zum Beispiel Oxidationskatalysatoren. Und wir verstehen es, die
passenden Wolframchemikalien herzustellen.

[Icon | Chemische Industrie | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

### [Medizintechnik][40]

Die Medizintechnik nutzt Wolfram, um Geräte leistungsfähiger und schonender zu machen.
Präzisionsbauteile aus Wolframmetall werden beispielsweise in der modernen Röntgendiagnostik und
-therapie eingesetzt, um harte Röntgen- oder Gammastrahlung abzuschirmen und zu fokussieren.

[Medizintechnik | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

### [Elektroindustrie][41]

Eine hohe thermische Belastbarkeit von Wolfram-Kupfer-Werkstoffen in Kombination mit sehr guten
Wärme- und guten elektrischen Leitfähigkeiten prädestinieren diese Materialien für Anwendungen in
elektrischen Hochleistungsschaltkontakten, als Wärmesenken in der Elektroindustrie oder zum Einsatz
als Erodierelektroden.

[Icon | H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders]

## Technologiemetallpulver von H.C. Starck Tungsten Powders

Wir verarbeiten wolframhaltige Recyclingmaterialien zu hochleistungsfähigen Wolframverbindungen und
-metall. Darüber hinaus bieten wir Tantal- und Niobcarbidpulver an. Auch für Sie entwickeln wir die
optimale Pulvermischung – sprechen Sie uns an!

# *
# Kermetico HVAF and HVOF Thermal  Spray Coating Equipment and Technology*

We design, manufacture and optimize HVAF and HVOF [thermal spray][81] coating equipment and utilize
this emerging technology in our spray [shop][82] to provide coating services in Benicia, California,
USA. We [spray][83] real-world jobs every day, and use this experience to constantly improve our
torches and systems to more effectively and efficiently produce coatings to meet and exceed our
customers most stringent requirements.  Everything we have in our product line has evolved or in
some way been improved by our spray work, this coating service is our real-world R&D lab.

**Gas Fuel Thermal Spray Systems**

**Kermetico**, Inc. manufactures HVAF and HVOF systems that are capable of operating a range of high
velocity spray guns for the efficient deposition of cemented [carbide ][84]and [metal ][85]coatings.

The coatings deposited with our **Kermetico** systems exhibit high density and hardness, combined
with excellent ductility, which results in best in market [wear ][86]and [cavitation ][87]resistance
of our impermeable, [corrosion-resistant][88] layers.

This high quality comes with the additional benefit of lower cost per unit of coating due to the
efficient use of energy which is unique to **Kermetico**, and which results in deposition rates four
to eight times higher than conventional HVOF.

The unique combination of high quality and low coating cost  also benefits from equipment that is
user friendly, and proven and improved on a daily basis in our northern California spray shop.


### Our HVAF and HVOF Thermal Spray Systems

#### [Convertible][89] HVAF and HVOF Equipment
* [C7][90]– an improved HVAF/[HVOF system][91] for spraying large parts
* [C6][92] – a general purpose HVAF/HVOF gun
* [CID][93] – an HVAF&HVOF gun to spray internal diameters

#### Multi-Purpose HVAF [AK Systems][94], With a Variety of Spray Guns
* [AK7][95] – a high-power gun for the thermal spray of large parts
* [AK6][96] – a gun to spray [tungsten ][97]and [chromium carbide][98] onto a balanced mix of parts
* [AK5][99] – a compact gun to spray smaller parts, thin walls and complex geometries
* [AK5][100] – a compact gun to spray internal diameters/bores 200 mm (8″) and larger
* [AK-ID][101] – an 88 mm (3.47”) and larger internal diameter/bore spray gun
* [AK-IDR][102] – a rotating ID gun to spray 4” (100 mm) and larger internal diameters/bores
* [AK-HH][103] – a user friendly handheld gun for on-site coating or small shop use

#### [Specialized][104] Equipment
* [SL][105] – a specialized gun for spraying low melting point metals, like [aluminum ][106]or
  [copper][107]
* [SP][108] – a dedicated gun for the most efficient precious metals’ deposition
* [STi][109] – a specialized gun for the deposition of titanium and Ti-alloy coatings

#### Auxiliary Equipment
* A [Grit Feeder][110] for the grit blast preparation of parts to reduce overall setup and
  application cost and time
* A [Gas Permeability Tester][111] for an instant and quantifiable check of a coating’s through
  porosity, now with Mass Flow

** Kermetico HVAF Technology in a Family of Thermal Spray Processes**

The key characteristics of each process are spray particle temperature and velocity, as achieved
during coating application.

Particles of different materials and various sizes are heated and accelerated very differently even
using the same method or even different spray guns within the same process.

It is useful to understand the various technological windows in thermal spray, as well as the trends
in equipment and ongoing technology development.

Kermetico HVAF, HVOF, Plasma, Detonation, Cold Spray Particle Temperature vs. Velocity

## Kermetico HVAF Coating Features

Kermetico HVAF tungsten [carbide ][112]coatings are generally superior to HVOF regarding
wear/erosion/cavitation resistance, corrosion protection and production cost. The higher particle
velocities (as compares to HVOF) ensure the densest possible coatings with high bond strength. Where
necessary, gas-tight coatings can be easily applied, which form an impermeable barrier protecting
components in highly corrosive and aggressive environments.

An Impermeable Kermetico WCCoCR Coating

The lower flame temperature (~2,000°C/3,600°F vs ~2,600°C/4,700°F for HVOF depending on fuel type)
is less destructive of the powder/feedstock, allowing for the best possible transfer of
powder/material properties to the applied coating.

An X-Ray Phase Analysis of a WCCoCr Powder(Black) and an HVAF-Sprayed Coating (Red)

Furthermore, utilizing compressed air (@~21% Oxygen) instead of the pure oxygen used in HVOF
processes, significantly reduces the oxide content in HVAF coatings, which is desirable for optimum
coating quality/properties.

Exploiting all of these benefits, Kermetico equipment produces WC based coatings with the highest
fracture toughness, substantially better than any HVOF process. Since the primary wear mechanism of
WC based coatings is attributed to the inherent brittleness of the material,  Kermetico’s HVAF
overlay exhibits better wear resistance than HVOF technology.

## Kermetico Inc. – Innovating and Commercializing HVAF Since 2006

We produce complete high velocity air and oxy fuel thermal spray systems. Since our incorporation in
2006, we have installed more than 150 of these systems in every major industrial market globally,
even Namibia.

While some of these systems are at work in Universities and National Labs, where the uniquely
superior coating properties are being explored, most of the systems are utilized daily in
established production thermal spray shops.

We equip our systems with a tailored range of spray guns to meet a broad range of industry
requirements; all engineered to be safe, reliable and technologically efficient.

**Kermetico HVAF systems provide industry leading applied coating cost, giving the best Return On
Investment in the industry.**

We proudly design, engineer, build and test all our thermal spray equipment in the USA and install
it across the planet. Our customers are our best advertisement, and we work closely with them to
support their day-to-day needs, along with providing ongoing updates as we continuously improve and
optimize our hardware, and the coatings it produces.

# *
# Kermetico HVAF and HVOF Thermal  Spray Coating Equipment and Technology*

We design, manufacture and optimize HVAF and HVOF [thermal spray][81] coating equipment and utilize
this emerging technology in our spray [shop][82] to provide coating services in Benicia, California,
USA. We [spray][83] real-world jobs every day, and use this experience to constantly improve our
torches and systems to more effectively and efficiently produce coatings to meet and exceed our
customers most stringent requirements.  Everything we have in our product line has evolved or in
some way been improved by our spray work, this coating service is our real-world R&D lab.

**Gas Fuel Thermal Spray Systems**

**Kermetico**, Inc. manufactures HVAF and HVOF systems that are capable of operating a range of high
velocity spray guns for the efficient deposition of cemented [carbide ][84]and [metal ][85]coatings.

The coatings deposited with our **Kermetico** systems exhibit high density and hardness, combined
with excellent ductility, which results in best in market [wear ][86]and [cavitation ][87]resistance
of our impermeable, [corrosion-resistant][88] layers.

This high quality comes with the additional benefit of lower cost per unit of coating due to the
efficient use of energy which is unique to **Kermetico**, and which results in deposition rates four
to eight times higher than conventional HVOF.

The unique combination of high quality and low coating cost  also benefits from equipment that is
user friendly, and proven and improved on a daily basis in our northern California spray shop.


### Our HVAF and HVOF Thermal Spray Systems

#### [Convertible][89] HVAF and HVOF Equipment
* [C7][90]– an improved HVAF/[HVOF system][91] for spraying large parts
* [C6][92] – a general purpose HVAF/HVOF gun
* [CID][93] – an HVAF&HVOF gun to spray internal diameters

#### Multi-Purpose HVAF [AK Systems][94], With a Variety of Spray Guns
* [AK7][95] – a high-power gun for the thermal spray of large parts
* [AK6][96] – a gun to spray [tungsten ][97]and [chromium carbide][98] onto a balanced mix of parts
* [AK5][99] – a compact gun to spray smaller parts, thin walls and complex geometries
* [AK5][100] – a compact gun to spray internal diameters/bores 200 mm (8″) and larger
* [AK-ID][101] – an 88 mm (3.47”) and larger internal diameter/bore spray gun
* [AK-IDR][102] – a rotating ID gun to spray 4” (100 mm) and larger internal diameters/bores
* [AK-HH][103] – a user friendly handheld gun for on-site coating or small shop use

#### [Specialized][104] Equipment
* [SL][105] – a specialized gun for spraying low melting point metals, like [aluminum ][106]or
  [copper][107]
* [SP][108] – a dedicated gun for the most efficient precious metals’ deposition
* [STi][109] – a specialized gun for the deposition of titanium and Ti-alloy coatings

#### Auxiliary Equipment
* A [Grit Feeder][110] for the grit blast preparation of parts to reduce overall setup and
  application cost and time
* A [Gas Permeability Tester][111] for an instant and quantifiable check of a coating’s through
  porosity, now with Mass Flow

** Kermetico HVAF Technology in a Family of Thermal Spray Processes**

The key characteristics of each process are spray particle temperature and velocity, as achieved
during coating application.

Particles of different materials and various sizes are heated and accelerated very differently even
using the same method or even different spray guns within the same process.

It is useful to understand the various technological windows in thermal spray, as well as the trends
in equipment and ongoing technology development.

Kermetico HVAF, HVOF, Plasma, Detonation, Cold Spray Particle Temperature vs. Velocity

## Kermetico HVAF Coating Features

Kermetico HVAF tungsten [carbide ][112]coatings are generally superior to HVOF regarding
wear/erosion/cavitation resistance, corrosion protection and production cost. The higher particle
velocities (as compares to HVOF) ensure the densest possible coatings with high bond strength. Where
necessary, gas-tight coatings can be easily applied, which form an impermeable barrier protecting
components in highly corrosive and aggressive environments.

An Impermeable Kermetico WCCoCR Coating

The lower flame temperature (~2,000°C/3,600°F vs ~2,600°C/4,700°F for HVOF depending on fuel type)
is less destructive of the powder/feedstock, allowing for the best possible transfer of
powder/material properties to the applied coating.

An X-Ray Phase Analysis of a WCCoCr Powder(Black) and an HVAF-Sprayed Coating (Red)

Furthermore, utilizing compressed air (@~21% Oxygen) instead of the pure oxygen used in HVOF
processes, significantly reduces the oxide content in HVAF coatings, which is desirable for optimum
coating quality/properties.

Exploiting all of these benefits, Kermetico equipment produces WC based coatings with the highest
fracture toughness, substantially better than any HVOF process. Since the primary wear mechanism of
WC based coatings is attributed to the inherent brittleness of the material,  Kermetico’s HVAF
overlay exhibits better wear resistance than HVOF technology.

## Kermetico Inc. – Innovating and Commercializing HVAF Since 2006

We produce complete high velocity air and oxy fuel thermal spray systems. Since our incorporation in
2006, we have installed more than 150 of these systems in every major industrial market globally,
even Namibia.

While some of these systems are at work in Universities and National Labs, where the uniquely
superior coating properties are being explored, most of the systems are utilized daily in
established production thermal spray shops.

We equip our systems with a tailored range of spray guns to meet a broad range of industry
requirements; all engineered to be safe, reliable and technologically efficient.

**Kermetico HVAF systems provide industry leading applied coating cost, giving the best Return On
Investment in the industry.**

# Global leader in surface technologies & advanced materials

At Oerlikon, we engineer innovative technologies and solutions that make our customers' products
last longer, perform better, and generate less waste. Our high-tech surface solutions and advanced
materials are designed for applications in the most demanding industries.
About us
We make products better with our integrated offering of advanced materials, coating equipment and
services, and component manufacturing. Our global network of highly skilled engineers and problem
solvers is combined with a strong local presence, ensuring we are always close to our customers.


1
Oerlikon at the bottom of the sea

Oerlikon makes metals ready for the deep sea: coatings and materials protect drill bits, valves,
pumps and seals against pressure, corrosion and wear. This increases reliability, lowers costs and
helps protect sensitive underwater environments.

[ Read the full story ][92]
2
Taking off safely and efficiently

From turbines to landing gear, Oerlikon technologies help make aircraft safer, more efficient and
more economical. Our coatings, superalloy components and 3D printed parts protect metal alloys
against extreme heat and loads, supporting the next generation of sustainable aviation.

[ Read the full story ][93]
3
High performance for high performance

Semiconductors power everything from smartphones to cars and AI data centers. Oerlikon supports the
industry with coatings, thermal interface materials and 3D printed components that protect chip
production equipment, improve heat management and help manufacturers push the limits of performance.

[ Read the full story ][94]
4
Sustainable, durable and safe mobility

Oerlikon supports the automotive industry with solutions that make mobility safer and more
sustainable. Our technologies protect battery systems, reduce weight, lower friction and improve
manufacturing efficiency, helping both drivers and manufacturers.

[ Read the full story ][95]

Heal better, recover faster

critical tasks in space. Our coatings and 3D printed components protect parts against extreme heat,

[ Read the full story ][97]
1/4

## Our business model – unique integrated offering

Discover Oerlikon's business model and find out how we make products better. Each part of our
offering has unique strengths, and when combined, these strengths are a true game-changer in terms
of extending product life, saving costs and improving sustainability.
Coating services
From drill bits that stay sharp longer to turbine blades that withstand extreme heat, Oerlikon’s
coating services enhance the performance and durability of critical components across a wide range
of industries.
Coating equipment
From PVD & CVD coaters to thermal spray guns and entire systems, our coating equipment ensures
best-in-class results.
[Metal powder piling up]
Advanced materials
At Oerlikon, we engineer materials that drive innovation. Our portfolio includes ultra-fine metal
and ceramic powders for thermal spray and for 3D printing, as well as high-performance wires – each
designed to withstand pressure, heat, and wear.
Highly specialized components
Oerlikon manufactures precision components that improve product performance, safety, and efficiency
in demanding environments.
Technology toolbox

## Leading know-how in high-tech sectors

Oerlikon has a highly developed technology toolbox that drives our business model. This toolbox
enables our customers to decrease costs, improve their products' performance, and gain a competitive
edge.
[Material science icon - magnifying glass on small particles]
Material Science
Through continuous innovation, we create advanced materials that enhance product performance,
reliability, and efficiency. Our technologies – often refined through powder metallurgy – help our
customers achieve higher durability, energy efficiency, and competitive advantage in their
industries.
[PVD icon - electrons bouncing off a target]
Physical Vapor Deposition
In the PVD process, a high-purity, solid coating material (metals) is either evaporated by heat (arc
evaporation) or by bombardment with ions (sputtering). At the same time, a reactive gas (e.g.,
nitrogen) is added. The gas forms a compound with the metal vapor, which is then deposited on the
tools or components as a thin, highly adherent coating.
[Thermal spray icon - spray from a spray gun]
Thermal Spray
Thermal spraying is a cost-effective method for applying coatings that enhance surface properties.
In the simplest terms, thermal spray involves heating a feedstock material, generally in powder or
wire form, to a molten or semi-molten state. The feedstock is propelled using a stream of gas or
compressed air to deposit it, creating a surface structure on a given substrate.
[Advanced manufacturing icon]
Advanced Manufacturing
Oerlikon manufactures precision components that improve product performance, safety, and efficiency
in demanding environments. Leveraging our expertise in additive metal manufacturing, we produce
lightweight, complex parts that enhance fuel efficiency in aerospace systems.

## 150 years of inventors and pioneers – watch the video to learn more about the 150-year history of
## Oerlikon

1/1

## PVD coatings enhance performance in electrosurgery

Macom Instrumental Cirúrgico’s journey with the Oerlikon **PVD coating BALIMED ARGENTA**.

A trusted partnership between Macom Instrumental Cirúrgico and Oerlikon Balzers delivers Brazil’s
most widely used bipolar forceps – combining antimicrobial protection and surgical precision.

In neurosurgery, where precision and sterility are paramount, the performance of surgical
instruments can directly influence patient outcomes. Macom Instrumental Cirúrgico, one of Brazil’s
leading manufacturers of surgical tools, faced a persistent challenge: tissue adhesion during
coagulation (sealing of small blood vessels) with bipolar forceps. The search for a more effective
and biocompatible solution led to a collaboration with Oerlikon Balzers’ antimicrobial coating:
BALIMED® ARGENTA.

[ Read more ][98]
1/1

## Thermal spray solutions extend range of Mazda MX-30 e-SKYACTIV R-EV

Innovation in the automotive industry has been a driving force for change towards sustainability and
efficiency. The MX-30 e-SKYACTIV R-EV exemplifies Mazda‘s innovative approach to automotive design.

By repurposing the traditional rotary engine (Wankel) as a range extender in a plug-in hybrid
powertrain, Mazda leveraged compactness and lightness to extend the vehicle‘s range significantly.

[ Read the full story ][99]
1/1

## PVD coatings replace PFAS for a safer and better tomorrow

Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), also usually called **“forever chemicals”**, have
attracted significant regulatory attention worldwide due to their indelible nature, potential health
risks, and environmental impact. These synthetic chemicals, used in numerous industrial and consumer
products from non-stick cookware to medical devices, mechanical seals as well as applications where
functional surfaces with non-sticking and low friction properties required.

[ Read more ][100]

# Global leader in surface technologies & advanced materials

At Oerlikon, we engineer innovative technologies and solutions that make our customers' products
last longer, perform better, and generate less waste. Our high-tech surface solutions and advanced
materials are designed for applications in the most demanding industries.
About us
We make products better with our integrated offering of advanced materials, coating equipment and
services, and component manufacturing. Our global network of highly skilled engineers and problem
solvers is combined with a strong local presence, ensuring we are always close to our customers.


1
Oerlikon at the bottom of the sea

Oerlikon makes metals ready for the deep sea: coatings and materials protect drill bits, valves,
pumps and seals against pressure, corrosion and wear. This increases reliability, lowers costs and
helps protect sensitive underwater environments.

[ Read the full story ][92]
2
Taking off safely and efficiently

From turbines to landing gear, Oerlikon technologies help make aircraft safer, more efficient and
more economical. Our coatings, superalloy components and 3D printed parts protect metal alloys
against extreme heat and loads, supporting the next generation of sustainable aviation.

[ Read the full story ][93]
3
High performance for high performance

Semiconductors power everything from smartphones to cars and AI data centers. Oerlikon supports the
industry with coatings, thermal interface materials and 3D printed components that protect chip
production equipment, improve heat management and help manufacturers push the limits of performance.

[ Read the full story ][94]
4
Sustainable, durable and safe mobility

Oerlikon supports the automotive industry with solutions that make mobility safer and more
sustainable. Our technologies protect battery systems, reduce weight, lower friction and improve
manufacturing efficiency, helping both drivers and manufacturers.

[ Read the full story ][95]
5
Heal better, recover faster

From ultra‑thin coatings on surgical instruments to porous implant surfaces, dental applications and
special 3D printing powders, Oerlikon helps make surgeries safer, implants more durable and recovery
faster. The technologies improve quality of life for millions of patients worldwide.

[ Read the full story ][96]
6
Endless space. Endless possibilities

From the first moon landing to today’s rockets and satellites, Oerlikon technologies perform
critical tasks in space. Our coatings and 3D printed components protect parts against extreme heat,
vacuum and friction and help make missions safer, lighter and more efficient.

[ Read the full story ][97]
1/4

## Our business model – unique integrated offering

Discover Oerlikon's business model and find out how we make products better. Each part of our
offering has unique strengths, and when combined, these strengths are a true game-changer in terms
of extending product life, saving costs and improving sustainability.
Coating services
From drill bits that stay sharp longer to turbine blades that withstand extreme heat, Oerlikon’s
coating services enhance the performance and durability of critical components across a wide range
of industries.
Coating equipment
From PVD & CVD coaters to thermal spray guns and entire systems, our coating equipment ensures
best-in-class results.
[Metal powder piling up]
Advanced materials
At Oerlikon, we engineer materials that drive innovation. Our portfolio includes ultra-fine metal
and ceramic powders for thermal spray and for 3D printing, as well as high-performance wires – each
designed to withstand pressure, heat, and wear.
Highly specialized components
Oerlikon manufactures precision components that improve product performance, safety, and efficiency
in demanding environments.
Technology toolbox

## Leading know-how in high-tech sectors

Oerlikon has a highly developed technology toolbox that drives our business model. This toolbox
enables our customers to decrease costs, improve their products' performance, and gain a competitive
edge.
[Material science icon - magnifying glass on small particles]
Material Science
Through continuous innovation, we create advanced materials that enhance product performance,
reliability, and efficiency. Our technologies – often refined through powder metallurgy – help our
customers achieve higher durability, energy efficiency, and competitive advantage in their
industries.
[PVD icon - electrons bouncing off a target]
Physical Vapor Deposition
In the PVD process, a high-purity, solid coating material (metals) is either evaporated by heat (arc
evaporation) or by bombardment with ions (sputtering). At the same time, a reactive gas (e.g.,
nitrogen) is added. The gas forms a compound with the metal vapor, which is then deposited on the
tools or components as a thin, highly adherent coating.
[Thermal spray icon - spray from a spray gun]
Thermal Spray
Thermal spraying is a cost-effective method for applying coatings that enhance surface properties.
In the simplest terms, thermal spray involves heating a feedstock material, generally in powder or
wire form, to a molten or semi-molten state. The feedstock is propelled using a stream of gas or
compressed air to deposit it, creating a surface structure on a given substrate.
[Advanced manufacturing icon]
Advanced Manufacturing
Oerlikon manufactures precision components that improve product performance, safety, and efficiency
in demanding environments. Leveraging our expertise in additive metal manufacturing, we produce
lightweight, complex parts that enhance fuel efficiency in aerospace systems.

## 150 years of inventors and pioneers – watch the video to learn more about the 150-year history of
## Oerlikon

## PVD coatings enhance performance in electrosurgery

Macom Instrumental Cirúrgico’s journey with the Oerlikon **PVD coating BALIMED ARGENTA**.

A trusted partnership between Macom Instrumental Cirúrgico and Oerlikon Balzers delivers Brazil’s
most widely used bipolar forceps – combining antimicrobial protection and surgical precision.

In neurosurgery, where precision and sterility are paramount, the performance of surgical
instruments can directly influence patient outcomes. Macom Instrumental Cirúrgico, one of Brazil’s
leading manufacturers of surgical tools, faced a persistent challenge: tissue adhesion during
coagulation (sealing of small blood vessels) with bipolar forceps. The search for a more effective
and biocompatible solution led to a collaboration with Oerlikon Balzers’ antimicrobial coating:
BALIMED® ARGENTA.

[ Read more ][98]
1/1

## Thermal spray solutions extend range of Mazda MX-30 e-SKYACTIV R-EV

Innovation in the automotive industry has been a driving force for change towards sustainability and
efficiency. The MX-30 e-SKYACTIV R-EV exemplifies Mazda‘s innovative approach to automotive design.

By repurposing the traditional rotary engine (Wankel) as a range extender in a plug-in hybrid
powertrain, Mazda leveraged compactness and lightness to extend the vehicle‘s range significantly.

[ Read the full story ][99]
1/1

## PVD coatings replace PFAS for a safer and better tomorrow

Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), also usually called **“forever chemicals”**, have
attracted significant regulatory attention worldwide due to their indelible nature, potential health
risks, and environmental impact. These synthetic chemicals, used in numerous industrial and consumer
products from non-stick cookware to medical devices, mechanical seals as well as applications where
functional surfaces with non-sticking and low friction properties required.

## Quick Questions Before Sending an Inquiry

Common questions about coating selection, sample trials, inspection and quotation preparation.

Which thermal spray process should I choose?
APT can review your drawing, base material, working condition, coating area, target thickness and
finishing requirement before recommending HVOF, plasma spray, arc spray, D-Gun or lab coating
support.
When should I choose HVOF coating?
HVOF coating is commonly used for dense carbide or metal alloy coatings requiring wear resistance,
erosion resistance, corrosion resistance or sealing surface protection.
When is plasma spray coating suitable?
Plasma spray coating is suitable for ceramic, oxide and high-temperature coating materials,
including alumina insulation coatings, zirconia thermal barrier coatings and chromium oxide wear
coatings.
Can APT prepare sample coatings before production?
Yes. APT can prepare coating coupons or sample components for coating appearance, thickness,
hardness, roughness and cross-section review before batch coating.
Can thermal spray coating restore worn dimensions?
Yes. Thermal spray coating can restore worn surfaces when the component allows surface preparation,
coating build-up and post-coating grinding or machining.
What inspection support can APT provide?
APT can support coating thickness checking, hardness testing, surface roughness review,
metallographic cross-section observation, coating appearance review and process documentation when
required.
What information is needed for a quotation?
Please provide component drawing, part photos, base material, coating area, working condition,
target coating thickness, surface finish requirement, tolerance, quantity and inspection needs.
Does APT also supply consumables and auxiliary equipment?
Yes. APT supplies selected thermal spray consumables and auxiliary equipment, including masking
materials, spray gun parts, water cables, powder hoses, rotary tables, powder feeders, chillers and
custom fixtures.

## Quick Questions Before Sending an Inquiry

Common questions about coating selection, sample trials, inspection and quotation preparation.

Which thermal spray process should I choose?
APT can review your drawing, base material, working condition, coating area, target thickness and
finishing requirement before recommending HVOF, plasma spray, arc spray, D-Gun or lab coating
support.
When should I choose HVOF coating?
HVOF coating is commonly used for dense carbide or metal alloy coatings requiring wear resistance,
erosion resistance, corrosion resistance or sealing surface protection.
When is plasma spray coating suitable?
Plasma spray coating is suitable for ceramic, oxide and high-temperature coating materials,
including alumina insulation coatings, zirconia thermal barrier coatings and chromium oxide wear
coatings.
Can APT prepare sample coatings before production?
Yes. APT can prepare coating coupons or sample components for coating appearance, thickness,
hardness, roughness and cross-section review before batch coating.
Can thermal spray coating restore worn dimensions?
Yes. Thermal spray coating can restore worn surfaces when the component allows surface preparation,
coating build-up and post-coating grinding or machining.
What inspection support can APT provide?
APT can support coating thickness checking, hardness testing, surface roughness review,
metallographic cross-section observation, coating appearance review and process documentation when
required.
What information is needed for a quotation?
Please provide component drawing, part photos, base material, coating area, working condition,
target coating thickness, surface finish requirement, tolerance, quantity and inspection needs.
Does APT also supply consumables and auxiliary equipment?
Yes. APT supplies selected thermal spray consumables and auxiliary equipment, including masking
materials, spray gun parts, water cables, powder hoses, rotary tables, powder feeders, chillers and
custom fixtures.

Our coating services can dramatically improve your equipment’s performance and extend its working
life. We offer turnkey thermal spray and cold spray coatings, as well as secondary services like
welding, machining, and grinding, to give our customers finished, ready-to-use treated parts.

With decades of experience in identifying the causes of wear, we can adapt our thermal spray and
cold spray surfacing technologies to best address the needs of your application.

and grinding capabilities, Hannecard - ASB can provide unique **[thermal spray][79]** and **[cold
spray][80]** solutions for extreme wear, high-temperature barriers, and all-encompassing part

# Hannecard - ASB: Innovative Industrial Coating Services

Our coating services can dramatically improve your equipment’s performance and extend its working
life. We offer turnkey thermal spray and cold spray coatings, as well as secondary services like
welding, machining, and grinding, to give our customers finished, ready-to-use treated parts.

With decades of experience in identifying the causes of wear, we can adapt our thermal spray and
cold spray surfacing technologies to best address the needs of your application.

[Industries Served][74]
[Roller Coverings][75]
[Thermal Sprays][76]
[Machining Capabilities][77]
[Cold Sprays][78]
 

## First-Class Industrial Coating Services

With advanced equipment, a skilled staff of thermal sprayers and machinists, and extensive machining
and grinding capabilities, Hannecard - ASB can provide unique **[thermal spray][79]** and **[cold
spray][80]** solutions for extreme wear, high-temperature barriers, and all-encompassing part
repair.

Our in-house, turnkey industrial coating services will give your equipment extended service life by
meeting or exceeding original equipment designs. **[Submit your project][81]** or **[contact
us][82]** today!

## The Thermal Spray & Cold Spray Experts

Our [industrial coating services][83] are ideal for a broad range of applications in almost every
industry. We work hard to create customized thermal spray and cold spray solutions for your unique
challenges. Our thermal spray/cold spray [capabilities][84] include:
* [HVOF Coatings][85]
* [Flame Spray Coatings][86]
* [Hard Coating Surfacing][87]
* [Roll Coatings][88]
* [Plasma Electric Arc Spray][89]
* [Plasma Transferred Arc Welding][90]
* [Electric Arc Spray][91]

Because our industrial coating services are custom specified to your project, you can count on
superior protection for and exceptional performance from your coated components. We will work with
you to develop and outline procedures to match your defined specifications.

  we're your access to 24/7 connected care.

  ### **24/7 Virtual**
  ### Urgent Care
  
  Get immediate medical advice from our ARC pediatric and adult medicine doctors and APCs on
  NormanMD, giving you easy access to virtual urgent care.
  
  [Learn More][111]
* [[photo of a pediatric doctor holding stethoscope to young patient and the words Our Commitment to
  you]][112]
* ## At ARC, patient care means connected care
  
  At Austin Regional Clinic, our patients benefit from “connected care.” With over 30 clinic
  locations in Central Texas, and a wide array of primary and specialty care physicians and APCs,
  the patient’s care is all within one medical group and “connected” with all of their care teams.
  
  In this video, you can hear from real ARC patients who talk about their experiences, highlighting
  their journey of care at ARC, and their appreciation of ARC’s team approach to keeping them
  healthy and connected.

* ## A journey
  ## of care

  their doctor or APC and care teams who guide their care to the people they want to live a
  healthier life for.

## Multimetal, now MM1018 - the first metal-polymer with building authority approval

Multimetal, our “liquid backing plate”, comes with polymer bonding which totallytransforms gap
compensation. This ensures your assembly process becomes quicker and safer, while also reducing
costs!

When you’re working on complex activities such as constructing a bridge or even a wind power plant,
multimetal is appropriate to use as it makes sure unevenness and imperfect flange connections are
taken care of.

There are a number of other advantages of using the tried-and-tested multimetal MM1018. It not only
helps save time and expenses, it is resistant to weather changes and chemical spillage. It is also
resistant to any pressure put on it and can become fully resilient in short period of time. It also
comes with general building authority approval.

## Seal and seal microporous metal with capillary action? seal!

When coatings are being treated using thermal spraying in a capillary-active manner, there are
always cracks, which need to be sealed. We manufacture dichtol, which is a 1-component polymer
system, to make sure metal can be sealed reliably. You can use dichtol for any kind of pores,
ranging from the smallest to the largest.

However, dichtol need not be used only in case of a crack. Instead, you can even use it as a
preventative measure. dichtol can permeate even the tiniest metal opening, so you can use it as
sealant without having to resort to mechanical or thermal stress.

## Liquid metal for surfaces: When things have to go fast!

Many a time, you would be in need of quick repairs for pipes or radiators. [The best solution][62]
for this is the liquid metal that we manufacture. It is a one-component cold metal that you can use
for repairs on metal surfaces for up to two millimetres of layer thickness.

The 1-Step-Metals that we have can be used as filler with the help of the appropriate tool. Once
they complete curing, you will see that they have completely adapted to the base material. We offer
different variants such as aluminium, steel, bronze, iron and cast iron.

## Quality is when the customer comes back - and not the product."

Our products can be used for small repairs or even for large-scale operations and can be utilised in
a wide variety of applications. You can benefits from the vast amount of experience we have in this
field as our products have been tried and tested repeatedly with complete success.

DIAMANT® offers you:
* Expert advice from specially trained and experienced staff
* Product development that is specific to every customer
* The assembly on site
* A product range that is accessibleall over the world
* The seal of quality
* Innovation of the highest quality

[Get in touch][63] with one of our service technicians to get more detailed information about all
the advantages and applications related to our products – we would be glad to assist you.

## Multimetal, now MM1018 - the first metal-polymer with building authority approval

Multimetal, our “liquid backing plate”, comes with polymer bonding which totallytransforms gap
compensation. This ensures your assembly process becomes quicker and safer, while also reducing
costs!

When you’re working on complex activities such as constructing a bridge or even a wind power plant,
multimetal is appropriate to use as it makes sure unevenness and imperfect flange connections are
taken care of.

There are a number of other advantages of using the tried-and-tested multimetal MM1018. It not only
helps save time and expenses, it is resistant to weather changes and chemical spillage. It is also
resistant to any pressure put on it and can become fully resilient in short period of time. It also
comes with general building authority approval.

## Seal and seal microporous metal with capillary action? seal!

When coatings are being treated using thermal spraying in a capillary-active manner, there are
always cracks, which need to be sealed. We manufacture dichtol, which is a 1-component polymer
system, to make sure metal can be sealed reliably. You can use dichtol for any kind of pores,
ranging from the smallest to the largest.

However, dichtol need not be used only in case of a crack. Instead, you can even use it as a
preventative measure. dichtol can permeate even the tiniest metal opening, so you can use it as
sealant without having to resort to mechanical or thermal stress.

## Liquid metal for surfaces: When things have to go fast!

Many a time, you would be in need of quick repairs for pipes or radiators. [The best solution][62]
for this is the liquid metal that we manufacture. It is a one-component cold metal that you can use
for repairs on metal surfaces for up to two millimetres of layer thickness.

The 1-Step-Metals that we have can be used as filler with the help of the appropriate tool. Once
they complete curing, you will see that they have completely adapted to the base material. We offer
different variants such as aluminium, steel, bronze, iron and cast iron.

### We like to think big. Imagining, innovating and producing engineering plastics and coatings that
### satisfy a wide range of needs.

## AFT Fluorotec – Advanced Polymer Specialists

We deliver custom seals, coatings and advanced fluoropolymer materials for mission-critical
applications across the aerospace, medical, and industrial sectors.

[Explore Our Materials][175] [01992 515880][176]

## Our Services

[Custom polymer coating][Custom polymer coating]

### Custom Polymer Compounding

We Custom compound bespoke polymer blends in-house to meet your exact performance needs.

[Read More][177]
[Fluoropolymer & Protective Coatings][Fluoropolymer & Protective Coatings]

### Fluoropolymer & Protective Coatings

We offer coatings that enhance performance, durability, and longevity in extreme environments

[Read More][178]
[Precision Machining (PTFE, PEEK, PCTFE)][Precision Machining (PTFE, PEEK, PCTFE)]

### Precision Machining (PTFE, PEEK, PCTFE)

We machine components to precise tolerances for use in seals, guides, insulators and more.

[Read More][179]
[Bespoke Seals & Components][Bespoke Seals & Components]

### Bespoke Seals & Components

We manufacture and deliver tailored sealing solutions and engineered components for mission-critical
applications, ensuring compliance with customer, statutory, and regulatory requirements

[Read More][180]

## Plastic Manufacturing Solutions

Precision-engineered components made to your exact specifications. We specialise in machining
high-performance plastics like PTFE, PEEK and PCTFE for critical applications.

[View Plastic Machining][181]

## Coating & Surface Preparation

Advanced fluoropolymer coatings that enhance performance, durability. Perfectly prepared surfaces
ensure lasting protection in extreme environments.

[View Coating Services][182]

## Why Fluorotec?

AFT Fluorotec manufactures precision-machined polymer components and applies high-performance
industrial coatings for demanding applications. From our UK facility in Welwyn Garden City, we
combine advanced material processing, precision CNC machining, and engineering-led support to
deliver reliable, fully traceable solutions optimised for real-world performance..

**30+ Years of Expertise – ISO-certified, industry-trusted solutions.**

**Material Science Specialists – Deep knowledge of fluoropolymers.**

**Rapid Prototyping – From concept to production in days.**

**End-to-End Support – Engineering assistance, testing, and QA.**

## RMS Acquires Fusion, Inc. Expanding its Service Offering to include Precision Grinding, Laser
## Cladding & Thermal Spray Coatings

Rotating Machinery Services (RMS), a premier provider of aftermarket solutions for critical rotating
equipment, is excited to announce the acquisition of Fusion Inc., a Houston-based precision grinding
and thermal spray coating company specializing in tight-tolerance grinding, CNC and manual
machining, laser cladding, and wear-resistant coating applications.

This acquisition significantly expands RMS’s vertically integrated manufacturing capabilities,
enhancing its ability to control quality, cost, and lead time across the full lifecycle of
turbomachinery overhauls. Fusion’s in-house expertise will immediately support RMS’s overhaul and
repair of steam turbines, expanders, compressors, and other high-performance rotating equipment.

## Metalizing

Metalizing, or Thermal Spray, is commonly used for long term corrosion protection of carbon steel or
concrete structures, e.g. valves, heat exchangers, ISO tanks and process vessels. Gartner Coatings
provides metalizing services at our Pearland area facilities as well as many customer locations.

Methods of Metalizing

Metalizing is a process that can be applied in three distinct ways. Gartner Coatings specializes in
flame spray and twin arc methods. These two methods offer superior protection to liquid applied
coatings in areas that have hot and cold cycles or areas that are exposed to high moisture like
drift zones from water coolers.

Flame Spray Coating

Flame spray is a technique that has been developed and used for over 100 years. This method utilizes
oxygen and a fuel like propylene to create the flame to melt the wire and propel with air to the
substrate. This form of metalizing can be shop or field applied with ease and has greater ability
for tight areas.

The flame spray coating method is commonly used for thermal sprayed aluminum (TSA), zinc or 85/15
zinc-aluminum wire. Thermal sprayed aluminum is commonly used on items like pipe, valves, exchangers
and pumps. Zinc and 85/15 are commonly used on bridges and interiors of ISO tanks for purity of
cargos.

Gartner has six state of the art systems with fully trained and certified applicators trained under
the Abrasive Products training program.

Twin Arc Spray

Twin Arc is a process that utilizes electricity to melt the wire and utilizes air to propel molten
material to substrate. This process has higher bond strength than flame spray due to the
temperatures at which the material is melted.

Twin Arc allows you to utilize products like nickel, inconel 625, 316L stainless and many other
high-grade alloys for protection on your equipment. This provides protection from not only surface
corrosion but also chemical attack from chemical exposure. The interior as well as the exterior can
be coated to provide the protection. Gartner utilizes state of the art equipment as well as
certified applicators for all your metalizing needs.

## Architectural Coatings

Gartner Coatings applies Valspar architectural coatings for aluminum paneling and extrusions. These
architectural coatings resist dirt pickup, chalking, fading and UV degradation and are available in
a broad range of colors.

Protect your building against harmful elements that may exist in moist environments such as salt air
with these coatings for aluminum. Many of these architectural coatings meet or exceed [all the
requirements of AAMA 2605][24].

We also offer in house color match capabilities through Valspar’s mix and match system.  This is a
state of the art system offered by Valspar to a very limit number of applicators.  Our team has 4
full time mix and match operators that are trained by Valspar.  This improves turn around time on
your projects and quality as this material can be produced and kept on file for all future repairs
or additions to the project.

## Tank Lining

With over 25 years of expertise in tank linings, Houston area Gartner Coatings is the company you
can rely on for [specialized tank lining services][26]. The leader in coating ISO tank containers
and OTR trailers for chemical and food grade services, we provide the right lining, on time, every
time.

DOT Accredited

We are the only Texas-DOT certified provider.  USDOT certificate #3597714 CT #15436

Ensuring the Right Coating, Every Time

Gartner works closely with the owners and manufacturers of coatings like [Sakaphen][27] Si14E and

with assurance we will deliver a high quality lining done safely.

## Metalizing

Metalizing, or Thermal Spray, is commonly used for long term corrosion protection of carbon steel or
concrete structures, e.g. valves, heat exchangers, ISO tanks and process vessels. Gartner Coatings
provides metalizing services at our Pearland area facilities as well as many customer locations.

Methods of Metalizing

Metalizing is a process that can be applied in three distinct ways. Gartner Coatings specializes in
flame spray and twin arc methods. These two methods offer superior protection to liquid applied
coatings in areas that have hot and cold cycles or areas that are exposed to high moisture like
drift zones from water coolers.

Flame Spray Coating

Flame spray is a technique that has been developed and used for over 100 years. This method utilizes
oxygen and a fuel like propylene to create the flame to melt the wire and propel with air to the
substrate. This form of metalizing can be shop or field applied with ease and has greater ability
for tight areas.

The flame spray coating method is commonly used for thermal sprayed aluminum (TSA), zinc or 85/15
zinc-aluminum wire. Thermal sprayed aluminum is commonly used on items like pipe, valves, exchangers
and pumps. Zinc and 85/15 are commonly used on bridges and interiors of ISO tanks for purity of
cargos.

Gartner has six state of the art systems with fully trained and certified applicators trained under
the Abrasive Products training program.

Twin Arc Spray

Twin Arc is a process that utilizes electricity to melt the wire and utilizes air to propel molten
material to substrate. This process has higher bond strength than flame spray due to the
temperatures at which the material is melted.

Twin Arc allows you to utilize products like nickel, inconel 625, 316L stainless and many other
high-grade alloys for protection on your equipment. This provides protection from not only surface
corrosion but also chemical attack from chemical exposure. The interior as well as the exterior can
be coated to provide the protection. Gartner utilizes state of the art equipment as well as
certified applicators for all your metalizing needs.

## We use thermal spray to help industrial companies...

• Repair and remanufacture worn and damaged components

• Prevent future wear, corrosion and cavitation damage

• Mitigate thermal and electrical conductivity

• Acheive their reliability and maintenance goals by extending the life of their components

[New to thermal spray?][66]

[industrial wear problems]

[industrial wear problems]

The everyday wear of production is hard on machine components. Thermal spray coatings can increase
wear resistance and cut maintenance time and costs.

[Learn More][67]
[Industrial Corrosion Problems]

[Industrial Corrosion Problems]

Corrosion affects many industrial components. Thermal spray protects against chemical and
environmental corrosion.

[Learn More][68]
[Cavitation Damage Problems]

[Cavitation Damage Problems]

HVAF thermal spray coatings are hard yet ductile and offer cavitation damage protection for most
pump components.

[Learn More][69]

## Repair & Overhaul

We are a full-service thermal spray, grinding, machining and welding facility. We specialize in
preventing wear from corrosion and erosion along with repair of components damaged in operation. We
have a long history of knowing how to make things work better and longer.

[Learn More][70]

  [How Do the Oil and Gas Industries Use Flame Spray?]
  
  ### How Do the Oil and Gas Industries Use Flame Spray?
  
  ][88]
  May 28, 2026
  
  Flame spray is a proven thermal spray coating process that helps protect critical oil and gas
  equipment from corrosion, erosion, extreme heat, and wear. From offshore platforms and subsea
  pipelines to pump shafts and refinery components, flame spray coatings extend equipment life,
  reduce downtime, and lower maintenance costs in some of the harshest environments on earth. This
  blog explores how industries use flame spray technology to improve reliability, refurbish worn
  components, and keep operations running efficiently.

  ### The Pros and Cons of Stellite Coatings
  
  ][106]
  March 11, 2026
  
  Stellite 6 is a cobalt-based alloy coating known for its exceptional wear resistance, hardness,
  and corrosion protection. Widely used in industries like oil and gas, manufacturing, and power
  generation, Stellite 6 coatings help extend the life of critical components exposed to extreme
  heat, abrasion, and chemical attack. Learn how Stellite 6 works, where it’s used, and the
  advantages and limitations of this high-performance coating.

## We use thermal spray to help industrial companies...

wear resistance and cut maintenance time and costs.

environmental corrosion.

pump components.

[Learn More][69]

We are a full-service thermal spray, grinding, machining and welding facility. We specialize in
preventing wear from corrosion and erosion along with repair of components damaged in operation. We
have a long history of knowing how to make things work better and longer.

  [How Do the Oil and Gas Industries Use Flame Spray?]
  
  ### How Do the Oil and Gas Industries Use Flame Spray?
  
  ][88]
  May 28, 2026
  
  Flame spray is a proven thermal spray coating process that helps protect critical oil and gas
  equipment from corrosion, erosion, extreme heat, and wear. From offshore platforms and subsea
  pipelines to pump shafts and refinery components, flame spray coatings extend equipment life,
  reduce downtime, and lower maintenance costs in some of the harshest environments on earth. This
  blog explores how industries use flame spray technology to improve reliability, refurbish worn
  components, and keep operations running efficiently.

  [The Pros and Cons of Stellite Coatings]
  
  ### The Pros and Cons of Stellite Coatings
  
  ][106]
  March 11, 2026
  
  Stellite 6 is a cobalt-based alloy coating known for its exceptional wear resistance, hardness,
  and corrosion protection. Widely used in industries like oil and gas, manufacturing, and power
  generation, Stellite 6 coatings help extend the life of critical components exposed to extreme
  heat, abrasion, and chemical attack. Learn how Stellite 6 works, where it’s used, and the
  advantages and limitations of this high-performance coating.

and price. As a national key Hi-Tech enterprise, the mission of XTC is to develop and expand Chinese
tungsten industry and new energy materials industry.

Chinese Yuan by end of 2020.

#### **Fluoropolymer Coatings**

Fluoropolymer coatings are used in a number of key applications. For example, where low friction or
non-stick is required. If corrosion resistance is the objective, then Halar (ECTFE) or PFA are often
used. Conductive coating versions are also available.
*[Fluoropolymer Coatings >>][178]

*

#### **TempCoat ®**

The TempCoat® range is the family name given to the fluoropolymer coatings applied by Impreglon UK.
The TempCoat® method creates a high quality polymer surface. These coatings have excellent sliding,
non-stick, release and dry lubrication properties and the TempCoat® process ensures that the coating
is securely anchored to the base material (substrate).

[*TempCoat >>*][179]


#### **Xylan® Coatings**

Click the link below for more information on xylan coatings.
[*xylan® coatings >>*][180]


#### **MagnaCoat ®**

MagnaCoat® surfaces are heavy-duty fluoropolymer coatings which are pinhole free. They can also
offer good non-stick properties and some have high electrical and impact resistance, even at
elevated temperatures. The coatings provide excellent barrier protection to resist aggressive
chemicals and other sources of corrosion. The MagnaCoat® range of coatings are probably the best
corrosion resistant coatings available.
[*MagnaCoat >>*][181]

 

#### **Low Friction Coatings**

Where low friction coatings are needed, PTFE coatings are usually used. Hard wearing low friction
coatings can be achieved when combining fluoropolymer coatings with plasma reinforcement (such as
stainless steel, Tungsten Carbide or ceramics).
[*Low Friction Coatings >>*][182]

#### **Anti Corrosion Coatings**

Special coatings that offer galvanic protection can be used to create a barrier layer. These
coatings corrode in preference to the substrate when the coating is damaged. In addition we have
corrosion resistant coatings where corrosion is prevented from happening due to the non-porous
nature of the protective coating.

These coatings, such as Halar, have thicknesses that range from around 200 microns to over 800
microns. Some of these coatings will withstand very aggressive and abrasive environments. Impreglon
chemical resistant coatings can be found throughout the chemicals and petrochemicals industries and
applied to parts ranging from valves to vessels.

fluoropolymers behave in different applications.

The PlasmaCoat® method combines the outstanding hardness and wear resistance of thermally sprayed

anti-microbial coating. 



Impreglon Japan is promoting it's new generation of sol-gel coating, Silicera Coat 8011. This
coating technology is available from Impreglon UK. Call us to find out more.

[Optical Coating Technologies][132], a subsidiary of Impreglon UK, applies the SafeCoat 400 series
coatings, a comprehensive range of abrasion resistant, chemical resistant, graffiti resistant and
anti-fog coatings for use on plastic components.

down sheets or CNC routed profiles. [Optical Coatings][133] is the UK and Ireland stockholder and
distributor for KRD of Germany.

Through our Optical Coatings facility, located just 6 miles from Impreglon UK, we can offer Gold,
Silver, Copper and Aluminium coating of flat plastics. These coatings are deposited in a vacuum
chamber and have a purity of 99.99%.

Our coatings are used wherever there is a need for low friction, non-stick, [traction][134], high
friction, easy clean, [hardness][135], cleanliness, aesthetics, chemical resistance, [corrosion
resistance][136], solvent resistance, impact resistance, sound deadening, insulation or
[anti-fog][137]. Food and medically safe coatings are available for most of these applications.

## 50+ Years of Asset Integrity

Since 1978, IGS has helped the world’s largest industrial operators extend asset life, reduce
maintenance costs, and ensure safer, more reliable operations.

###### Case Study

### Sour Gas Corrosion Remediation in Qatar

Located in Ras Laffan, this LNG facility relies on large slug catchers to manage sour gas flow,
requiring robust protection against internal corrosion.

[Read the full story][140]

###### Case Study

### Offshore Slug Catcher Corrosion Mitigation Saves $7.78M

Located offshore, this production platform plays a key role in upstream oil and gas operations,
managing the complex separation of well fluids through two large slug catchers.

[Read the full story][141]

###### Case Study

The shock tubes had moderate hydrocarbon buildup mixed with rust and plating, while the finned tubes
suffered from extreme buildup of thick hydrocarbons between all finned areas.

# KL Coatings

Your Partner in Surface Engineering Solutions


ISO9001:2015 | AS9100D | NADCAP | FAA Repair Station (Approval Pending)

KL Coatings, Inc. is best known as a thermal spray coatings house that has branched out to be so
much more.  From protective thermal spray coatings and powder coatings to machining, production
assembly, we strive to be an engineering solutions provider.  We concentrate on efficient and lean
operations, which allow us to be competitive in price and turnaround time.

### Coating Technologies
* Atmospheric Plasma Spray (APS)
* High Velocity Oxygen Fuel (HVOF)
* Wire Arc Spray
* Plasma Electrolytic Oxidation
* Boronizing
* Low Pressure Plasma Spray (LPPS)
* Powder Coating
* Specialty Painting (MIL-C-81751)

### Coating Materials
* Tungsten Carbide Variations
* Chrome Carbide Variations
* MCrAlY Coatings
* Thermal Barrier Coatings
* Chrome Oxide
* Aluminum Oxide
* Aluminum Bronze
* Metallic Coatings
* T-400 and T-800 Coatings
* Customer Specific Coatings
* MIL-C-81751 Metallic Ceramic Coatings

### Engineered coating solutions available for:
* Temperature Gradient Management
* Heat Protection
* Corrosion Resistance
* Oxidation Resistance
* Wear Resistance
* Abrasion Resistance
* High/Low Electric Conductivity
* High/Low Thermal Conductivity
* High/Low Friction
* Dimensional Restoration
* Dielectric Strength
* EMI/RFI Shielding

# Other Services

## Industrial Processes
* Production Assembly
* Abrasive Blasting (60” x 72” x 72” volume)
* Full Metallurgical Laboratory
* Mechanical Testing (Microhardness, Macrohardness, Tensile Testing)
* NDT: Computed Thermography (CT)
* Grinding
* Baking
* Source Inspection

## Machining
* CNC Milling
* CNC Turning
* CNC Grinding
* Laser Marking

## Industries we serve:
* Space Exploration
* Aerospace and Defense
* Automotive
* Oil and gas
* Semiconductor and Electronics
* Medical Devices
